description.value: The Likely Branch is a small community library operated by the Cariboo Regional District Library system, serving the remote village of Likely in BC's Cariboo region. It is staffed by Community Librarian Beverly Fox and offers borrowing services, digital resources, and programmes as part of the broader CLN network. For touring cyclists passing through this isolated area along Keithley Creek Road, it represents one of the few publicly accessible indoor stopping points in the community.
